plan.title: Liver treated vs control: descriptive 1v1 fold changes
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a single bulk RNA-seq count matrix (/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv, 12000 genes x 3 columns = gene symbol + 2 sample columns, raw integer salmon gene-level counts, Homo sapiens liver) with a 2 x 2 metadata table giving one treated and one control sample. The research question asks which genes are differentially expressed between them. The design has no biological replication (n = 1 per condition), so within-group variance cannot be estimated and no dispersion, no standard error, and therefore no p-value or FDR has any inferential basis. The Inflexa knowledge service returns this as a hard flag (R-0003@6b3a, outcome descriptive_only) and forbids every inferential DE method for this situation. The plan therefore does NOT run DESeq2/edgeR/limma hypothesis testing. It does what the data can support: (T1S1) QC and normalization — library sizes, detection counts, median-of-ratios size factors computed on the raw counts without pre-scaling, and a blind variance-stabilizing transform, with the explicit statement that PCA and sample-distance clustering are uninformative with two samples; (T1S2) a descriptive ranked table of log2(treated/control) on size-factor-normalized counts with the contrast named explicitly as condition, numerator = treated, denominator = control, plus an MA plot showing the expression-dependence of the fold-change noise, and an explicit no-p-value statement; (T1S3) an exploratory, clearly-labelled hypothesis-generation pass — rank-based gene set enrichment on the full descriptive log2FC ranking against hallmark gene sets, which is the only interpretive layer that partially tolerates the absence of replication because it aggregates across many genes, and which must be reported as hypothesis-generating only, degrading to a plain ranked-gene report if no gene set collection is provisioned (the reference store is currently empty); (T1S4) the reproducibility and limitations report naming the design that would support inference. Nothing in this plan produces a statistically supported DE gene list, and every step is required to say so. Package availability could not be read from the farm inventory, so each step must probe its imports (R requireNamespace / python import) and fall back to a base-R or pandas/numpy implementation of median-of-ratios normalization and log ratios, which requires no specialist package.

Descriptive only: ranked log2 fold changes of normalized counts, no inferential test, no p-values (R-0003 flag, n=1 per group)
Reproducibility report: method, package versions, design, no-replication limitation, number of genes tested and ranked, replicated design needed for inference
Sample structure QC: vst(blind), PCA, sample distances, library sizes
Low count filter: keep a gene with at least 10 counts in at least the smallest group size of samples
Descriptive contrast specification, no dispersion estimable: factor condition, numerator treated, denominator control
Descriptive only: normalized counts and descriptive log2 fold changes, no inferential test and no p-values (design has no replication)
Reproducibility report of method, versions, design, thresholds, tested genes, and the no-replication limitation

steps.description: Assemble the final report for this 1-treated vs 1-control human liver bulk RNA-seq analysis. Lead with the conclusion: differential expression cannot be established from this dataset — with one sample per condition there is no within-group variance, no dispersion estimate, and therefore no valid p-value or FDR, so the analysis delivers a descriptive ranking only. Then record: the input files and their dimensions (counts.csv 12000 genes x 2 samples, metadata.csv 2 samples), the sample-to-condition mapping, the QC numbers from T1S1 (library sizes, genes detected, genes retained by the >=10-count filter, size factors), the contrast as factor condition / numerator treated / denominator control, the expression floor and ranking used in T1S2, the number of genes ranked, the count of genes reported as differentially expressed (zero — none can be, and state why), the enrichment configuration and its exploratory status or its absence from T1S3, every package with its version, and the full session information. Close with the design that would support inference: at least 3 and preferably 5 or more independent biological replicates per condition, processed across the same batches, which permits a negative-binomial model with dispersion estimation, apeglm shrinkage of the fold changes, and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control. State that the descriptive ranking from T1S2 is a legitimate source of candidate genes for such a follow-up and nothing more.
steps.context: The report is the deliverable that prevents the descriptive ranking from being read as a DE result. It must be unambiguous about the absence of inference.
acceptance_criteria: The report leads with the statement that no differentially expressed genes can be identified from a 1v1 design, with the reason
Number of DE genes is reported as zero/not-determinable with the explanation, rather than omitted
Method, package versions, design and contrast, filter and ranking thresholds, number of genes tested/ranked, and session information are all present
The enrichment configuration (collection, version, ranking metric, universe, size window, tool, adjustment) is recorded, or its absence is recorded if no collection was provisioned
Enrichment findings are labelled method-dependent and hypothesis-generating
A concrete replicated design (>=3, preferably >=5 biological replicates per condition) is named as the requirement for inferential differential expression
No language in the report implies a statistically supported differential expression finding
constraints: Do not soften the no-replication limitation or bury it below the gene tables
Do not report any p-value or FDR for gene-level differential expression
Report package versions as actually resolved at run time, not as assumed
caveats: Readers commonly mistake a ranked fold-change table for a DE result; the report must forestall that explicitly

grounding.reason: Report names method, package versions, design and contrast, thresholds, n tested, n DE, and session info (R-0041); records the enrichment database, version, ranking metric, universe and size window (R-0051) and its method-dependence (R-0055); and states the no-replication limitation with the design that supports inference, as R-0003 requires.
